story.head: Unstoppable force vs. Immovable object
paras: The Bruins (10-4-1) beat Chicago 5-4 in overtime on Oct 31, and the Panthers have won three straight. The Panthers played last night, and the Bruins are rested. This is an Atlantic Division matchup, with the Panthers fifth (tied for eighth in the NHL) and the Bruins first (fourth). The Atlantic has been the strongest of the four divisions so far.
The Panthers’ record (.643) is about what their chances are worth. The Bruins’ record (.700) is running ahead of what their chances are worth (.552), largely thanks to their goaltending.

The Panthers forecheck harder than anyone (1st), rarely ice the puck (1st) and hit a lot (1st). The Bruins have had the league’s best goaltending (1st) and leave the shooting to their forwards (2nd lowest). They also sit back rather than chase on the forecheck (2nd lowest), so the Cats hound the puck, but them sit back. Boston has allowed 2.40 goals a game, the fourth fewest in the league. The Bruins’ good looks will be harder to come by against the Panthers.

Matthew Tkachuk (4 G / 16 A / 20 P in 14 GP) leads the Panthers in scoring, and Brady Tkachuk (8 G / 7 A / 15 P in 14 GP) has a team-high eight goals. The Bruins’ scoring runs through David Pastrňák (8 G / 11 A / 19 P in 15 GP), who has seven points in his last five games and a point in five straight games against Florida.
Cooper Black (0-1-0 / .850 SV% in 1 GS) is in line to start for Florida. Jeremy Swayman (7-3-1 / .912 SV% in 11 GS) has been a rock in net for Boston and will likely start.
At home, Marco Sturm likes to send Mittelstadt, Lindholm and Hagens out against the other team’s top line, so watch for them against Verhaeghe, Reinhart and Vilmanis.

items.text: The Panthers have been without Jacob Markström, Aleksander Barkov and Brad Marchand for several games. Cooper Black is expected to start.
Sam Reinhart has seven goals in ten games against Boston since 2023-24.
Connor Clifton has missed the Bruins’ latest game.
Carter Verhaeghe has eight goals on chances worth about 4.5 goals, well above what his finishing usually turns chances into. Runs like that tend to cool off.
